create_perplexity_metric: create a Perplexity metric instance for measuring language model prediction quality
update_perplexity_with_predictions: update the Perplexity metric with model predictions and target tokens
compute_perplexity_score: compute the final Perplexity score from accumulated log probabilities and token count
use_perplexity_with_ignore_index: use the Perplexity metric with an ignore_index to skip masked tokens
test_perplexity_correctness: test that Perplexity computes exp(average(nll)) instead of average(exp(nll))
